# Miauterm 0.1.8-coral

This release follows 0.1.7. It is still experimental.

## Fixes

- The first-run progress bar now advances steadily and reaches 100% before the shell opens. Progress no longer drops backward when extraction reports a lower value.
- The notification permission prompt no longer appears twice during startup.
- The extraction progress dialog starts at 0% and uses a determinate bar on all devices.

## Known issues

This release does not fix every reported problem. Some issues remain open:

- Debian startup and the bundled rootfs can still fail on some devices.
- Some dialog and tab touch targets remain below 48 dp.
- The app keeps `targetSdk 28`, which leaves some notification and storage permission behavior inconsistent on newer Android versions.
- A broader audit found additional bugs and quality issues that are not addressed in this release.

Use this build for testing, not as a guaranteed bug-free release. Report problems with a diagnostic log from Settings.
